verses.text: Jacob called all his sons together and said, “Come close. I’m going to tell you what will happen to you in the days ahead.” 📜
“Gather around and listen, sons of Jacob. Hear your father Israel.” 👂
“Reuben, you are my firstborn, my strength, the first sign of my power. You were first in honor and might.” 🥇
“But you surged like floodwater, so you won’t keep that place of honor. You climbed into your father’s bed and dishonored it—you went up onto my couch.” Jacob named the wrong plainly. ⚠️
“Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords became weapons of violence.” 🗡️
“I will not join their secret plans or their assembly. In anger they killed men; in their own will they crippled cattle.” Jacob rejected their violent ways. 🛑
“Their fierce anger and cruel rage are cursed. I will divide them among Jacob’s people and scatter them through Israel.” Their choices carried consequences. ⚖️
“Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will hold your enemies by the neck, and your father’s sons will bow before you.” 👑
“Judah is a lion’s cub. You return from the prey, my son. He crouches and lies down like a lion—like a lioness. Who would dare stir him?” 🦁
“The ruler’s staff will stay with Judah; the leader’s rod will remain among his descendants until the rightful one comes. The peoples will obey him.” 👑
“He ties his foal to a vine, his donkey’s colt to the finest vine. He washes his clothes in wine, his robes in grape juice.” 🍇
“His eyes are dark from wine, and his teeth are white from milk.” 🍷
“Zebulun will live by the seacoast and become a harbor for ships; his border will reach toward Sidon.” ⚓
“Issachar is a strong donkey resting between its packs.” 🫏
“He saw that his resting place was good and the land pleasant. He bent his shoulder to the burden and became a servant forced to work.” Jacob spoke of the cost too. 🧱
“Dan will judge his people as one of Israel’s tribes.” ⚖️
“Dan will be a snake beside the road, a viper on the path, biting a horse’s heels so its rider falls backward.” 🐍
“I have waited for your salvation, LORD.” Jacob cried out to God. 🙏
“Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will strike back at their heels.” 🛡️
“Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.” 🍲
“Naphtali is a doe set free, bearing beautiful fawns.” 🦌
“Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine beside a spring; his branches climb over the wall.” 🌿
“Archers attacked him fiercely, shot at him, and kept pursuing him.” 🏹
“Yet his bow stayed firm, his arms stayed strong, through the hands of Jacob’s Mighty One—Israel’s shepherd and rock.” 💪
“That strength came from your father’s God, who helps you, from the Almighty, who blesses you with heaven’s blessings above, the deep below, and blessings of the breasts and womb.” 🙏
“Your father’s blessings surpass the blessings of my ancestors and reach the ancient hills. They will rest on Joseph’s head, on the crown of him set apart from his brothers.” 🌄
“Benjamin is a ravenous wolf: in the morning he devours prey, and in the evening he divides the plunder.” 🐺
These were Israel’s twelve tribes. Their father spoke to them and blessed each one with the blessing meant for him. ✨
Jacob gave them this instruction: “I’m about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite—” 🕯️
“—in the cave at Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, the field Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.” 📍
“There they buried Abraham and his wife Sarah. They buried Isaac and his wife Rebekah there, and I buried Leah there too.” 🪦
“The field and the cave in it were purchased from the Hittites.” Jacob was clear about the burial place. 📜
When Jacob finished instructing his sons, he drew his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and was gathered to his people. His life came to its close. 🕊️
